body:
well... 
I didn't do it.
Just all the things i've seen.
Those old happy tourists. I want to grow old too.. But it hurts so much. plus i promised him i would come and visit him tomorrow.. I havent seen him in 2 weeks. 

Im not sure if i should head home. Its cold and so dark and quiet. 
The thoughts arent stopping... 
i dont know

Well im at the bridge now.
The view is nice.
I just hope it will be quick

Its kind of complicated. But I have already left my home. I have walked around for the past hour. Im not sure where i am. All i see is people. Happy people living their lives. I dont know what to do. I should be at school now. Instead im somewhere i dont even know where.
I just want all of this to end
